sections.heading: Overview

sections.content:
The first stage of our state-of-the-art Advanced Manufacturing Research Facility (AMRF) located in Bradfield City Centre, is scheduled to open later this year.
Suppliers of Workshop ICT equipment now have the opportunity to become qualified vendors to the AMRF.
This will enable the AMRF team to develop a robust supply chain to maintain a world class advanced manufacturing facility.
Successful applicants will be on a panel for two years, with an option for a third year extension, for the supply of metrology equipment for the facility.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
For the purposes of this ITR, the term Workshop ICT refers to information and communication technology products. Workshop ICT items are crucial for the efficiency and functionality of the manufacturing process, but they are not permanent components of the end products. Managing and replenishing Workshop ICT is an integral part of maintaining a safe and productive manufacturing operation.
The proposed scope of the Workshop ICT Procurement Panel will include the following (but not limited to):
o Audio/ Visual Equipment
o Digital Process Control
o Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) Devices
o Sensors and Actuators
o Environmental Monitoring
o Other
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
All submissions must be submitted electronically via email to amrfpanels@wpca.sydney.
The ITR will remain open for submissions for the duration of the contract until 31 August 2026. Any submissions received will be evaluated every quarter starting, October 2024, then January 2025, April 2025, July 2025, October 2025 and January 2026, April 2026, July 2026
